```{r}
#import dataset

PALMARES2_2025 <- read_excel("C:/Users/leona/Desktop/PALMARES-2/PALMARES2_2025/CUTOFF_01.2025/DATABASE/PALMARES2_2025_CURATED.xlsx")

###DATA PRE-PROCESSING
#outcome classes definition
PALMARES2_ML <- subset(PALMARES2_2025, PALMARES2_2025$PFS_event == 1 | (PALMARES2_2025$PFS_event == 0 & PALMARES2_2025$PFS_time >=6))
PALMARES2_ML$PFS6 <- as.factor(ifelse(PALMARES2_ML$PFS_time <= 6, 1, 0))

#One-hot encoding of categorical, non-binary, non-ordinal variables
dummy <- dummyVars("~ CDK46i_Drug + Histology + ET_adj_type + Endocrine_Resistance_Type + Center_size + HRD", data=PALMARES2_ML)
PALMARES2_ML_dummy <- data.frame(predict(dummy, newdata = PALMARES2_ML))
PALMARES2_ML <- cbind(PALMARES2_ML, PALMARES2_ML_dummy)
#exclude variables: Center_sizeMedium_Burden, HistologyOther, ET_adj_typeSEQUENTIAL, Endocrine_Resistance_TypeEndocrine_Sensitive, CDK46i_DrugAbemaciclib, HRDUnknown
PALMARES2_ML <- PALMARES2_ML %>%  rename(Primary_Resistance = Endocrine_Resistance_TypePrimary_Endocrine_Resistant)
PALMARES2_ML <- PALMARES2_ML %>%  rename(Secondary_Resistance = Endocrine_Resistance_TypeSecondary_Endocrine_Resistant)

###Select variables of interest

cor_matrix <- cor(num_df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

###check no near-zero variance variables (<5%)

  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 0))

missing_plot <- plot_grid(missing_plot_nolab, missing_plot_lab, ncol = 2, align = "hv", axis = "tb", rel_widths = c(1,1), labels = c("a", "b"), label_size = 15, label_fontface = "bold", label_x = 0, label_y = 0.98)

#exclude baseline LDH, ALP, glycemia, CA153 (due to missings)
PALMARES2_ML <- PALMARES2_ML %>% select(- c(LDH_Baseline, ALP_Baseline, Glycemia_Baseline, CA153_Baseline))

lab_variables <- c("WBC_Baseline", "Neu_Baseline", "Lymph_Baseline", "PLT_Baseline", "Mono_Baseline", "Eosino_Baseline", "Baso_Baseline", "NLR", "PLR", "PIV", "MCV_Baseline", "AST_Baseline", "ALT_Baseline", "Bili_Baseline", "Crea_Baseline")

##Select "Fondazione IRCCS Istituto Nazionale dei Tumori, Milan" as independent validation set
PALMARES2_extval <- subset(PALMARES2_ML, PALMARES2_ML$CENTRO == "INT")
PALMARES2_ML <- subset(PALMARES2_ML, PALMARES2_ML$CENTRO != "INT")

##splitting training/test set
set.seed(51)
splitIndex <- createDataPartition(PALMARES2_ML$PFS6, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
PALMARES2_train <- PALMARES2_ML[splitIndex, ]
PALMARES2_test <- PALMARES2_ML[-splitIndex, ]

#save pre-imputed dataset for further analyses
PALMARES2_train_pre_imputation <- PALMARES2_train
PALMARES2_train$PFS6 <- as.numeric(as.character(PALMARES2_train$PFS6))

#create an index variable for patients who have at least one laboratory measurement, for subsequent analyses
PALMARES2_train <- PALMARES2_train %>% mutate(lab_values = as.numeric(if_else(if_any(c("WBC_Baseline", "Neu_Baseline", "Lymph_Baseline", "PLT_Baseline",  "Mono_Baseline", "Eosino_Baseline", "Baso_Baseline", "NLR", "PLR", "PIV", "MCV_Baseline", "AST_Baseline", "ALT_Baseline", "Bili_Baseline", "Crea_Baseline"), ~ !is.na(.)), 1, 0)))
PALMARES2_test <- PALMARES2_test %>% mutate(lab_values = as.numeric(if_else(if_any(c("WBC_Baseline", "Neu_Baseline", "Lymph_Baseline", "PLT_Baseline", "Mono_Baseline", "Eosino_Baseline", "Baso_Baseline", "NLR", "PLR", "PIV", "MCV_Baseline", "AST_Baseline", "ALT_Baseline", "Bili_Baseline", "Crea_Baseline"), ~ !is.na(.)), 1, 0)))
PALMARES2_extval <- PALMARES2_extval %>% mutate(lab_values = as.numeric(if_else(if_any(c("WBC_Baseline", "Neu_Baseline", "Lymph_Baseline", "PLT_Baseline", "Mono_Baseline", "Eosino_Baseline", "Baso_Baseline", "NLR", "PLR", "PIV", "MCV_Baseline", "AST_Baseline", "ALT_Baseline", "Bili_Baseline", "Crea_Baseline"), ~ !is.na(.)), 1, 0)))

#create a progressive index variable for patient identification, for subsequent analyses
PALMARES2_train <- PALMARES2_train %>% mutate(index = as.numeric(row_number()))
PALMARES2_test <- PALMARES2_test %>% mutate(index = as.numeric(row_number()))
PALMARES2_extval <- PALMARES2_extval %>% mutate(index = as.numeric(row_number()))

#create a dataset with indices and outcomes, for subsequent analyses (survival)
PALMARES2_train_KM <- PALMARES2_train %>% select(index, PFS6, PFS_time, PFS_event, OS_time, OS_event)
PALMARES2_test_KM <- PALMARES2_test %>% select(index, PFS6, PFS_time, PFS_event, OS_time, OS_event)
PALMARES2_extval_KM <- PALMARES2_extval %>% select(index, PFS6, PFS_time, PFS_event, OS_time, OS_event)

#save vector with center of enrollment, for subsequent analyses (fairness)
PALMARES2_test_centers <- PALMARES2_test$CENTRO

PALMARES2_train <- PALMARES2_train %>% select(-CENTRO, -PFS_time, -PFS_event, -OS_time, -OS_event, -Second_line, -PFS_date, -OS_date)
PALMARES2_test <- PALMARES2_test %>% select(-CENTRO, -PFS_time, -PFS_event, -OS_time, -OS_event, -Second_line, -PFS_date, -OS_date)
PALMARES2_extval <- PALMARES2_extval %>% select(-CENTRO, -PFS_time, -PFS_event, -OS_time, -OS_event, -Second_line, -PFS_date, -OS_date)

#save dataset with cohort belonging, for subsequent analyses (characteristics comparison among training, test and independent validation cohorts)
PALMARES2_train_supplementary_table <- PALMARES2_train %>% mutate(Cohort = "Training set", PFS6 = as.factor(PFS6))
PALMARES2_test_supplementary_table <- PALMARES2_test %>% mutate(Cohort = "Test set", PFS6 = as.factor(PFS6))
PALMARES2_extval_supplementary_table <- PALMARES2_extval %>% mutate(Cohort = "Independent validation set", PFS6 = as.factor(PFS6))
PALMARES2_supplementary_table <- bind_rows(PALMARES2_train_supplementary_table, PALMARES2_test_supplementary_table, PALMARES2_extval_supplementary_table)


#definition of RWD and RWD+LAB cohorts
PALMARES2_train_RWD <- PALMARES2_train %>% select(-all_of(c("WBC_Baseline", "Neu_Baseline", "Lymph_Baseline", "PLT_Baseline", "Mono_Baseline", "Eosino_Baseline", "Baso_Baseline", "NLR", "PLR", "PIV", "MCV_Baseline", "AST_Baseline", "ALT_Baseline", "Bili_Baseline", "Crea_Baseline")))
PALMARES2_train_RW_pre_imputation <- PALMARES2_train_RWD
PALMARES2_test_RWD <- PALMARES2_test %>% select(-all_of(c("WBC_Baseline", "Neu_Baseline", "Lymph_Baseline", "PLT_Baseline", "Mono_Baseline", "Eosino_Baseline", "Baso_Baseline", "NLR", "PLR", "PIV", "MCV_Baseline", "AST_Baseline", "ALT_Baseline", "Bili_Baseline", "Crea_Baseline")))
PALMARES2_extval_RWD <- PALMARES2_extval %>% select(-all_of(c("WBC_Baseline", "Neu_Baseline", "Lymph_Baseline", "PLT_Baseline", "Mono_Baseline", "Eosino_Baseline", "Baso_Baseline", "NLR", "PLR", "PIV", "MCV_Baseline", "AST_Baseline", "ALT_Baseline", "Bili_Baseline", "Crea_Baseline")))

PALMARES2_train_RWDLAB <- PALMARES2_train %>% filter(if_any(c("WBC_Baseline", "Neu_Baseline", "Lymph_Baseline", "PLT_Baseline", "Mono_Baseline", "Eosino_Baseline", "Baso_Baseline", "MCV_Baseline", "AST_Baseline", "ALT_Baseline", "Bili_Baseline", "Crea_Baseline"), ~ !is.na(.)))
PALMARES2_train_RWDLAB_pre_imputation <- PALMARES2_train_RWDLAB
PALMARES2_test_RWDLAB <- PALMARES2_test %>% filter(if_any(c("WBC_Baseline", "Neu_Baseline", "Lymph_Baseline", "PLT_Baseline", "Mono_Baseline", "Eosino_Baseline", "Baso_Baseline", "MCV_Baseline", "AST_Baseline", "ALT_Baseline", "Bili_Baseline", "Crea_Baseline"), ~ !is.na(.)))
PALMARES2_extval_RWDLAB <- PALMARES2_extval %>% filter(if_any(c("WBC_Baseline", "Neu_Baseline", "Lymph_Baseline", "PLT_Baseline", "Mono_Baseline", "Eosino_Baseline", "Baso_Baseline", "MCV_Baseline", "AST_Baseline", "ALT_Baseline", "Bili_Baseline", "Crea_Baseline"), ~ !is.na(.)))



#imputing NA in the RWD cohort (bagged trees imputation)
#definition of preprocessing model on training set
recipe_rwd <- recipe(PFS6 ~ ., data = PALMARES2_train_RWD) %>% update_role(PFS6, new_role = "outcome") %>% step_impute_bag(all_predictors())

#fit the model only on training set
recipe_rwd_trained <- prep(recipe_rwd, training = PALMARES2_train_RWD)

#apply the model on training set
PALMARES2_train_RWD <- bake(recipe_rwd_trained, new_data = NULL)

#apply the model on test and independent validation sets
PALMARES2_test_RWD <- bake(recipe_rwd_trained, new_data = PALMARES2_test_RWD)
PALMARES2_extval_RWD <- bake(recipe_rwd_trained, new_data = PALMARES2_extval_RWD)

#create an imputed dataset with indices and outcomes, for subsequent analyses (benchmarking with existing biomarkers)
PALMARES2_test_benchmark <- PALMARES2_test_RWD %>% select(index, PFS6, Endocrine_Resistance, Luminal)
PALMARES2_extval_benchmark <- PALMARES2_extval_RWD %>% select(index, PFS6, Endocrine_Resistance, Luminal)
PALMARES2_test_benchmark <- PALMARES2_test_benchmark %>% mutate(PFS_time  = PALMARES2_test_KM$PFS_time, PFS_event = PALMARES2_test_KM$PFS_event, OS_time   = PALMARES2_test_KM$OS_time, OS_event  = PALMARES2_test_KM$OS_event)
PALMARES2_extval_benchmark <- PALMARES2_extval_benchmark %>% mutate(PFS_time  = PALMARES2_extval_KM$PFS_time, PFS_event = PALMARES2_extval_KM$PFS_event, OS_time   = PALMARES2_extval_KM$OS_time, OS_event  = PALMARES2_extval_KM$OS_event)

#same imputation in the RWD+LAB cohorts
recipe_rwdlab <- recipe(PFS6 ~ ., data = PALMARES2_train_RWDLAB) %>% update_role(PFS6, new_role = "outcome") %>% step_impute_bag(all_predictors()) 
recipe_rwdlab_trained <- prep(recipe_rwdlab, training = PALMARES2_train_RWDLAB)
PALMARES2_train_RWDLAB <- bake(recipe_rwdlab_trained, new_data = NULL)
PALMARES2_test_RWDLAB <- bake(recipe_rwdlab_trained, new_data = PALMARES2_test_RWDLAB)
PALMARES2_extval_RWDLAB <- bake(recipe_rwdlab_trained, new_data = PALMARES2_extval_RWDLAB)


###data distribution visualization and comparison pre and post missing imputation
#RWD continuous variables
combined_dfrw <- bind_rows(PALMARES2_train_RW_pre_imputation %>% mutate(Status = "Before imputation"), PALMARES2_train_RWD %>% mutate(Status = "After imputation"))
vars_to_plot_rwcont <- c("Ki67_combined", "PgR_combined", "Adj_ET_duration", "ER_combined")

plot_data_longrwd <- combined_dfrw %>% select(Status, all_of(vars_to_plot_rwcont)) %>% pivot_longer(cols = all_of(vars_to_plot_rwcont), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>% filter(!is.na(Value))
pvals_rwd <- plot_data_longrwd %>% group_by(Variable) %>% summarise(p_value = wilcox.test(Value ~ Status)$p.value, .groups = "drop") %>% mutate(label = paste0("p = ", signif(p_value, 2)))

prepost_missing_distribution_rwd_cont <- ggplot(plot_data_longrwd, aes(x = Value, color = Status, fill = Status)) +
  geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(density) * 100), alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ Variable, scales = "free") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Before imputation" = "#00305d", "After imputation" = "#81144e")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Before imputation" = "#00305d", "After imputation" = "#81144e")) +
  labs(x = "Value", y = "Proportion") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = NULL), color = guide_legend(title = NULL)) + 
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  geom_text(data = pvals_rwd, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = label), hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 4, inherit.aes = FALSE)

#RWD categorical variables
vars_to_plotrwcat <- c("PS_ECOG", "HistologyCLI", "Grading_combined", "HER2_combined")
combined_dfrw <- combined_dfrw %>% mutate(PS_ECOG = case_when(PS_ECOG %in% c(2, 3, 4) ~ ">=2", TRUE ~ as.character(PS_ECOG)))

plot_data_long <- combined_dfrw %>%
  select(Status, as.numeric(all_of(vars_to_plotrwcat))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(vars_to_plotrwcat), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value)) %>%
  group_by(Variable, Status, Value) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Variable, Status) %>%
  mutate(Percent = Count / sum(Count) * 100)

pvals_cat <- combined_dfrw %>%
  select(Status, as.numeric(all_of(vars_to_plotrwcat))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = all_of(vars_to_plotrwcat), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value)) %>%
  group_by(Variable) %>%
  summarise(p_value = chisq.test(table(Status, Value))$p.value, .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("p = ", signif(p_value, 2)))

prepost_missing_distribution_rwd_cat <- ggplot(plot_data_long, aes(x = factor(Value), y = Percent, fill = Status)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~ Variable, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Before imputation" = "#00305d", "After imputation" = "#81144e")) +
  labs(x = "Variable", y = "%") +
  theme_minimal() +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = NULL)) + 
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  geom_text(data = pvals_cat, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = label), hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 4, inherit.aes = FALSE)
```

```{r}
###PFS6 models

customSummary <- function(data, lev = NULL, model = NULL) {
  cm <- confusionMatrix(data = data$pred, reference = data$obs)
  accuracy <- cm$overall['Accuracy']
  sensitivity <- cm$byClass['Sensitivity']
  specificity <- cm$byClass['Specificity']
  recall <- cm$byClass['Recall']
  precision <- cm$byClass['Precision']
  balanced_accuracy <- (cm$byClass['Sensitivity'] + cm$byClass['Specificity'])/2
  f1 <- 2 * ((precision * recall) / (precision + recall))
  c(Accuracy = accuracy, Sensitivity = sensitivity, Specificity = specificity, F1 = f1, Precision = precision, Bal_Acc = balanced_accuracy)
}

trainControlObj_rwd <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",                
  number = 10,                  
  summaryFunction = customSummary,  
  classProbs = TRUE,
  index = folds_rwd,
  savePredictions = "final",     
  verboseIter = TRUE
)

trainControlObj_rwdlab <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",                
  number = 10,                  
  summaryFunction = customSummary,  
  classProbs = TRUE,
  index = folds_rwdlab,
  savePredictions = "final",     
  verboseIter = TRUE
)

trainControlObj_lab <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",                
  number = 10,                  
  summaryFunction = customSummary,  
  classProbs = TRUE,
  index = folds_rwdlab,
  savePredictions = "final",

)

  mtry = c(2,2,7,7,15,15,30,30),

  min.node.size= c(1, 5, 10)
)

###hyperparameters for linear model

  lambda = seq(0.0001, 1, length = 10)
)

###hyperparameters for xgboost

  nrounds = c(100, 200),
  max_depth = c(3, 5),
  eta = c(0.01, 0.3),
  gamma = c(0, 1),
  colsample_bytree = c(0.5, 0.7),
  min_child_weight = c(1, 3),
  subsample = c(0.5, 0.7)
)

###hyperparameters for nn

  bag = c(TRUE, FALSE)      
)

### Metamodel training on real patients (excluding SMOTE) with RWD and LAB features: pair model predictions across models using index vector from original dataset (index = 0 excluded, as produced with SMOTE process)
#RF
oof_pred_rf_rwd <- model_rf_rwd$pred %>% dplyr::mutate(index = PALMARES2_train_RWD$index[rowIndex])
oof_pred_rf_lab <- model_rf_lab$pred %>% dplyr::mutate(index = PALMARES2_train_LAB$index[rowIndex])

df_oof_pred_rf_rwd <- oof_pred_rf_rwd %>% filter(index != 0) %>% select(index, obs, pred_rwd = EARLY_PROGRESSOR)
df_oof_pred_rf_lab <- oof_pred_rf_lab %>% filter(index != 0) %>% select(index, pred_lab = EARLY_PROGRESSOR)

common_idx_oof_pred_rf_lab <- intersect(df_oof_pred_rf_rwd$index, df_oof_pred_rf_lab$index)
df_oof_pred_rf_rwd_common <- df_oof_pred_rf_rwd %>% filter(index %in% common_idx_oof_pred_rf_lab)
df_oof_pred_rf_lab_common <- df_oof_pred_rf_lab %>% filter(index %in% common_idx_oof_pred_rf_lab)
df_oof_pred_rf <- df_oof_pred_rf_rwd_common %>% left_join(df_oof_pred_rf_lab_common, by = "index")

folds_meta <- createFolds(df_oof_pred_rf$obs, k = 10, list = TRUE, returnTrain = TRUE)

#random forest metamodel training
set.seed(51)
meta_model_rf <- train(
  obs ~ .,
  data = df_oof_pred_rf %>% select(-index),
  method = "glmnet", 
  family = "binomial",
  tuneGrid = expand.grid(alpha = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2), lambda = seq(0.01, 1, length = 10)),
  weights = ifelse(df_oof_pred_rf$obs == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR",1,2),
  trControl = trainControl(method = "cv", number = 10, classProbs = TRUE, summaryFunction = customSummary, index = folds_meta,
  savePredictions = "final",  verboseIter = TRUE),
  metric = "Bal_Acc.Sensitivity"
)

oof_pred_rf_rwd <- oof_pred_rf_rwd %>% dplyr::mutate(lab_value = PALMARES2_train_RWD$lab_values[rowIndex])

probs_rf_metatrain <- c(meta_model_rf$pred$EARLY_PROGRESSOR, oof_pred_rf_rwd$EARLY_PROGRESSOR[oof_pred_rf_rwd$lab_value != 1])
actuals_rf_metatrain <- c(meta_model_rf$pred$obs, oof_pred_rf_rwd$obs[oof_pred_rf_rwd$lab_value != 1])

cm_train_metamodel_rf <- confusionMatrix(factor(ifelse(probs_rf_metatrain > 0.5, "EARLY_PROGRESSOR", "LATE_PROGRESSOR"), levels = levels(meta_model_rf$pred$obs)), actuals_rf_metatrain,  positive = "EARLY_PROGRESSOR")

#RF model evaluation on meta-test set (fallback strategy: if LAB feature available, use metamodel prediction, otherwise RWD model prediction)
probs_rf_rwd_test <- predict(model_rf_rwd, newdata = PALMARES2_test_RWD, type = "prob")[,"EARLY_PROGRESSOR"]
probs_rf_lab_test <- predict(model_rf_lab, newdata = PALMARES2_test_LAB, type = "prob")[,"EARLY_PROGRESSOR"]
meta_rf_test <- PALMARES2_test_RWD %>% dplyr::select(index, PFS6) %>% left_join(data.frame(index = PALMARES2_test_RWD$index, pred_rwd = probs_rf_rwd_test),
    by = "index") %>% left_join(data.frame(index = PALMARES2_test_LAB$index, pred_lab = probs_rf_lab_test), by = "index")
probs_rf_meta_test <- predict(meta_model_rf, newdata = meta_rf_test, type = "prob")[,"EARLY_PROGRESSOR"]

PALMARES2_test_RWD_NOLAB <- PALMARES2_test_RWD[PALMARES2_test_RWD$lab_values == 0,]
probs_rf_rwd_nolab_test <- predict(model_rf_rwd, newdata = PALMARES2_test_RWD_NOLAB, type = "prob")[,"EARLY_PROGRESSOR"]

probs_rf_metatest <- c(probs_rf_meta_test, probs_rf_rwd_nolab_test)
actuals_rf_metatest <- c(PALMARES2_test_RWDLAB$PFS6, PALMARES2_test_RWD_NOLAB$PFS6)

cm_test_metamodel_rf <- confusionMatrix(factor(ifelse(probs_rf_metatest > 0.5, "EARLY_PROGRESSOR", "LATE_PROGRESSOR")), actuals_rf_metatest,  positive = "EARLY_PROGRESSOR")

#model evaluation on meta-external validation set
probs_rf_rwd_extval <- predict(model_rf_rwd, newdata = PALMARES2_extval_RWD, type = "prob")[,"EARLY_PROGRESSOR"]
probs_rf_lab_extval <- predict(model_rf_lab, newdata = PALMARES2_extval_LAB, type = "prob")[,"EARLY_PROGRESSOR"]
meta_rf_extval <- PALMARES2_extval_RWD %>% dplyr::select(index, PFS6) %>% left_join(data.frame(index = PALMARES2_extval_RWD$index, pred_rwd = probs_rf_rwd_extval),
    by = "index") %>% left_join(data.frame(index = PALMARES2_extval_LAB$index, pred_lab = probs_rf_lab_extval), by = "index")
probs_rf_meta_extval <- predict(meta_model_rf, newdata = meta_rf_extval, type = "prob")[,"EARLY_PROGRESSOR"]

PALMARES2_extval_RWD_NOLAB <- PALMARES2_extval_RWD[PALMARES2_extval_RWD$lab_values == 0,]
probs_rf_rwd_nolab_extval <- predict(model_rf_rwd, newdata = PALMARES2_extval_RWD_NOLAB, type = "prob")[,"EARLY_PROGRESSOR"]

probs_rf_metaextval <- c(probs_rf_meta_extval, probs_rf_rwd_nolab_extval)
actuals_rf_metaextval <- c(PALMARES2_extval_RWDLAB$PFS6, PALMARES2_extval_RWD_NOLAB$PFS6)

cm_extval_metamodel_rf <- confusionMatrix(factor(ifelse(probs_rf_metaextval > 0.5, "EARLY_PROGRESSOR", "LATE_PROGRESSOR")), actuals_rf_metaextval,  positive = "EARLY_PROGRESSOR")

oof_pred_glmnet_lab <- model_glmnet_lab$pred %>% dplyr::mutate(index = PALMARES2_train_LAB$index[rowIndex])

####MLP training using Keras
#install_keras()
early_stop <- callback_early_stopping(monitor = "val_auc", patience = 50, restore_best_weights = TRUE)

x_mlp_rwd <- model.matrix(~ . - PFS6 - lab_values - index, data = PALMARES2_train_RWD)
y_mlp_rwd <- as.numeric(ifelse(PALMARES2_train_RWD$PFS6 == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR",1,0))

xtest_mlp_rwd <- model.matrix(~ . - PFS6 - lab_values - index, data = PALMARES2_test_RWD)
ytest_mlp_rwd <- as.numeric(ifelse(PALMARES2_test_RWD$PFS6 == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR",1,0))

xextval_mlp_rwd <- model.matrix(~ . - PFS6 - lab_values - index, data = PALMARES2_extval_RWD)
yextval_mlp_rwd <- as.numeric(ifelse(PALMARES2_extval_RWD$PFS6 == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR",1,0))

of_pred_mlp_rwd_list <- list()

###keras evaluation on 10fold cv - RWD
set.seed(51) 

results_mlp_rwd <- data.frame(
  balanced_accuracy = numeric(), 
  sensitivity = numeric(), 
  specificity = numeric(), 
  precision = numeric(), 
  F1 = numeric()
)

for (i in 1:10) {
  cat("\nFold", i, "...\n")
  set.seed(51 + i)
  train_index <- folds_rwd[[i]]
  valid_index <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(x_mlp_rwd)), train_index)
  x_train_mlp_rwd <- x_mlp_rwd[train_index, ]
  y_train_mlp_rwd <- y_mlp_rwd[train_index]
  x_valid_mlp_rwd  <- x_mlp_rwd[valid_index, ]
  y_valid_mlp_rwd  <- y_mlp_rwd[valid_index]
  model_mlp_rwd <- keras_model_sequential() %>%
    layer_dense(units = 128, activation = "relu", input_shape = ncol(x_mlp_rwd)) %>%
    layer_dropout(rate = 0.2) %>%
    layer_dense(units = 64, activation = "relu") %>%
    layer_dropout(rate = 0.2) %>%
    layer_dense(units = 8, activation = "relu") %>%
    layer_dropout(rate = 0.2) %>%
    layer_dense(units = 1, activation = "sigmoid")
  model_mlp_rwd %>% compile(loss = "binary_crossentropy", optimizer = optimizer_adam(learning_rate = 1e-3), metrics = c("accuracy", metric_auc())  )  
  model_mlp_rwd %>% fit(
    x_train_mlp_rwd, y_train_mlp_rwd,
    epochs = 100,
    batch_size = 64,
    validation_split = 0.2,
    callbacks = list(early_stop),
    verbose = 0)
  y_pred_prob_mlp_rwd <- model_mlp_rwd %>% predict(x_valid_mlp_rwd)
  y_pred_mlp_rwd <- ifelse(y_pred_prob_mlp_rwd >= 0.5, 1, 0)
  y_valid_mlp_rwd <- factor(y_valid_mlp_rwd, levels = c(0, 1))
  y_pred_mlp_rwd <- factor(y_pred_mlp_rwd, levels = c(0, 1))
  cm_mlp_rwd <- confusionMatrix(y_pred_mlp_rwd, y_valid_mlp_rwd, positive = "1")
  results_mlp_rwd <- rbind(results_mlp_rwd, data.frame(balanced_accuracy = cm_mlp_rwd$byClass["Balanced Accuracy"], sensitivity = cm_mlp_rwd$byClass["Sensitivity"], specificity = cm_mlp_rwd$byClass["Specificity"], precision = cm_mlp_rwd$byClass["Precision"], F1 = cm_mlp_rwd$byClass["F1"]))
  fold_df <- data.frame(index = PALMARES2_train_RWD$index[valid_index], obs = y_valid_mlp_rwd, pred_prob = y_pred_prob_mlp_rwd, lab_values = PALMARES2_train_RWD$lab_values[valid_index], fold = i)
  of_pred_mlp_rwd_list[[i]] <- fold_df    
}

print(results_mlp_rwd)
print(colMeans(results_mlp_rwd, na.rm = TRUE))

#calculation of the media of results from 10 folds
results_mlp_rwd_mean <- colMeans(results_mlp_rwd)

#retrain on the whole dataset for test/extval metrics computation
model_mlp_rwd <- keras_model_sequential() %>%
    layer_dense(units = 128, activation = "relu", input_shape = ncol(x_mlp_rwd)) %>%
    layer_dropout(rate = 0.2) %>%
    layer_dense(units = 64, activation = "relu") %>%
    layer_dropout(rate = 0.2) %>%
    layer_dense(units = 8, activation = "relu") %>%
    layer_dropout(rate = 0.2) %>%
    layer_dense(units = 1, activation = "sigmoid")

model_mlp_rwd %>% compile(loss = "binary_crossentropy", optimizer = optimizer_adam(learning_rate = 1e-3), metrics = c("accuracy", metric_auc()))
model_mlp_rwd %>% fit(x_mlp_rwd, y_mlp_rwd, epochs = 100, batch_size = 64, validation_split = 0.2, callbacks = list(early_stop), verbose = 0)

cm_extval_mlp_rwd <- confusionMatrix(factor(ifelse(predict(model_mlp_rwd, xextval_mlp_rwd[, !colnames(xextval_mlp_rwd) %in% c("index", "lab_values"), drop = FALSE])[,1] > 0.5, 1, 0), levels = c(0,1)), yextval_mlp_rwd <- factor(yextval_mlp_rwd, levels = c(0, 1)),  positive = "1")

#retrain on the whole dataset for test/extval metrics computation

    layer_dense(units = 128, activation = "relu", input_shape = ncol(x_mlp_lab)) %>%
    layer_dropout(rate = 0.2) %>%
    layer_dense(units = 64, activation = "relu") %>%
    layer_dropout(rate = 0.2) %>%
    layer_dense(units = 8, activation = "relu") %>%
    layer_dropout(rate = 0.2) %>%
    layer_dense(units = 1, activation = "sigmoid")

model_mlp_lab %>% compile(loss = "binary_crossentropy", optimizer = optimizer_adam(learning_rate = 1e-4), metrics = c("accuracy", metric_auc()))
model_mlp_lab %>% fit(x_mlp_lab, y_mlp_lab, epochs = 100, batch_size = 64, validation_split = 0.2, callbacks = list(early_stop), verbose = 0)

###final table results
Model <- c("LR", "RF", "XGB", "avNNet", "MLP", "TabPFN", "LR", "RF", "XGB", "avNNet", "MLP", "TabPFN", "LR", "RF", "XGB", "avNNet", "MLP", "TabPFN")
Data <- c("RWD", "RWD", "RWD", "RWD", "RWD", "RWD", "RWD+LAB (early fusion)", "RWD+LAB (early fusion)", "RWD+LAB (early fusion)", "RWD+LAB (early fusion)", "RWD+LAB (early fusion)", "RWD+LAB (early fusion)", "RWD+LAB (late fusion)", "RWD+LAB (late fusion)", "RWD+LAB (late fusion)", "RWD+LAB (late fusion)", "RWD+LAB (late fusion)", "RWD+LAB (late fusion)")

cm_test_list <- list(cm_test_rwd_glmnet, cm_test_rwd_rf, cm_test_rwd_xgb, cm_test_rwd_nn, cm_test_mlp_rwd, cm_test_tabpfn_rwd, cm_test_rwdlab_glmnet, cm_test_rwdlab_rf, cm_test_rwdlab_xgb, cm_test_rwdlab_nn, cm_test_mlp_rwdlab, cm_test_tabpfn_rwdlab, cm_test_metamodel_glmnet, cm_test_metamodel_rf, cm_test_metamodel_xgb, cm_test_metamodel_nn, cm_test_metamodel_mlp, cm_meta_test)
cm_extval_list <- list(cm_extval_rwd_glmnet, cm_extval_rwd_rf, cm_extval_rwd_xgb, cm_extval_rwd_nn, cm_extval_mlp_rwd, cm_extval_tabpfn_rwd, cm_extval_rwdlab_glmnet, cm_extval_rwdlab_rf, cm_extval_rwdlab_xgb, cm_extval_rwdlab_nn, cm_extval_mlp_rwdlab, cm_extval_tabpfn_rwdlab, cm_extval_metamodel_glmnet, cm_extval_metamodel_rf, cm_extval_metamodel_xgb, cm_extval_metamodel_nn, cm_extval_metamodel_mlp, cm_meta_extval)

Balanced_Accuracy_Test <- Sensitivity_Test <- Specificity_Test <- rep(NA_character_, length(cm_test_list))
Balanced_Accuracy_Independent_validation <- Sensitivity_Independent_validation <- Specificity_Independent_validation <- rep(NA_character_, length(cm_extval_list))

for (i in seq_along(cm_test_list)) {
  cm <- cm_test_list[[i]]
  tab <- as.matrix(cm$table)
  tmp <- data.frame()
  for (pr in rownames(tab)) {
    for (tr in colnames(tab)) {
      n_cell <- tab[pr, tr]
      if (n_cell > 0) tmp <- bind_rows(tmp, data.frame(pred = rep(pr, n_cell), truth = rep(tr, n_cell)))
    }
  }
  tmp$pred <- factor(tmp$pred, levels = colnames(tab))
  tmp$truth <- factor(tmp$truth, levels = colnames(tab))
  boot_res <- replicate(B, {
    idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(tmp)), replace = TRUE)
    d <- tmp[idx, ]
    TP <- sum(d$pred == positive_class & d$truth == positive_class, na.rm = TRUE)
    FN <- sum(d$pred != positive_class & d$truth == positive_class, na.rm = TRUE)
    FP <- sum(d$pred == positive_class & d$truth != positive_class, na.rm = TRUE)
    TN <- sum(d$pred != positive_class & d$truth != positive_class, na.rm = TRUE)
    sens <- ifelse(TP + FN > 0, TP / (TP + FN), NA_real_)
    spec <- ifelse(TN + FP > 0, TN / (TN + FP), NA_real_)
    balacc <- mean(c(sens, spec), na.rm = TRUE)
    c(Balanced_Accuracy = balacc, Sensitivity = sens, Specificity = spec)
  })
  balacc_ci <- quantile(boot_res["Balanced_Accuracy", ], probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
  sens_ci <- quantile(boot_res["Sensitivity", ], probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
  spec_ci <- quantile(boot_res["Specificity", ], probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
  Balanced_Accuracy_Test[i] <- paste0(sprintf("%.2f", cm$byClass["Balanced Accuracy"]), " (95% CI ", sprintf("%.2f", balacc_ci[1]), "–", sprintf("%.2f", balacc_ci[2]), ")")
  Sensitivity_Test[i] <- paste0(sprintf("%.2f", cm$byClass["Sensitivity"]), " (95% CI ", sprintf("%.2f", sens_ci[1]), "–", sprintf("%.2f", sens_ci[2]), ")")
  Specificity_Test[i] <- paste0(sprintf("%.2f", cm$byClass["Specificity"]), " (95% CI ", sprintf("%.2f", spec_ci[1]), "–", sprintf("%.2f", spec_ci[2]), ")")
}

for (i in seq_along(cm_extval_list)) {
  cm <- cm_extval_list[[i]]
  tab <- as.matrix(cm$table)
  tmp <- data.frame()
  for (pr in rownames(tab)) {
    for (tr in colnames(tab)) {
      n_cell <- tab[pr, tr]
      if (n_cell > 0) tmp <- bind_rows(tmp, data.frame(pred = rep(pr, n_cell), truth = rep(tr, n_cell)))
    }
  }
  tmp$pred <- factor(tmp$pred, levels = colnames(tab))
  tmp$truth <- factor(tmp$truth, levels = colnames(tab))
  boot_res <- replicate(B, {
    idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(tmp)), replace = TRUE)
    d <- tmp[idx, ]
    TP <- sum(d$pred == positive_class & d$truth == positive_class, na.rm = TRUE)
    FN <- sum(d$pred != positive_class & d$truth == positive_class, na.rm = TRUE)
    FP <- sum(d$pred == positive_class & d$truth != positive_class, na.rm = TRUE)
    TN <- sum(d$pred != positive_class & d$truth != positive_class, na.rm = TRUE)
    sens <- ifelse(TP + FN > 0, TP / (TP + FN), NA_real_)
    spec <- ifelse(TN + FP > 0, TN / (TN + FP), NA_real_)
    balacc <- mean(c(sens, spec), na.rm = TRUE)
    c(Balanced_Accuracy = balacc, Sensitivity = sens, Specificity = spec)
  })
  balacc_ci <- quantile(boot_res["Balanced_Accuracy", ], probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
  sens_ci <- quantile(boot_res["Sensitivity", ], probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
  spec_ci <- quantile(boot_res["Specificity", ], probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
  Balanced_Accuracy_Independent_validation[i] <- paste0(sprintf("%.2f", cm$byClass["Balanced Accuracy"]), " (95% CI ", sprintf("%.2f", balacc_ci[1]), "–", sprintf("%.2f", balacc_ci[2]), ")")
  Sensitivity_Independent_validation[i] <- paste0(sprintf("%.2f", cm$byClass["Sensitivity"]), " (95% CI ", sprintf("%.2f", sens_ci[1]), "–", sprintf("%.2f", sens_ci[2]), ")")
  Specificity_Independent_validation[i] <- paste0(sprintf("%.2f", cm$byClass["Specificity"]), " (95% CI ", sprintf("%.2f", spec_ci[1]), "–", sprintf("%.2f", spec_ci[2]), ")")
}

metrics_all <- data.frame(
  Model = Model,
  Data = Data,
  Balanced_Accuracy_Test = Balanced_Accuracy_Test,
  Sensitivity_Test = Sensitivity_Test,
  Specificity_Test = Specificity_Test,
  Balanced_Accuracy_Independent_validation = Balanced_Accuracy_Independent_validation,
  Sensitivity_Independent_validation = Sensitivity_Independent_validation,
  Specificity_Independent_validation = Specificity_Independent_validation,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

stat_delta_centers <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- data[indices, ]
  d1 <- d[d$Region == "North or Center Italy", ]
  d2 <- d[d$Region == "South Italy", ]
  TP1 <- sum(d1$PFS6_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR" & d1$pred_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR")
  FN1 <- sum(d1$PFS6_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR" & d1$pred_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR")
  FP1 <- sum(d1$PFS6_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR"  & d1$pred_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR")
  TN1 <- sum(d1$PFS6_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR"  & d1$pred_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR")
  TP2 <- sum(d2$PFS6_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR" & d2$pred_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR")
  FN2 <- sum(d2$PFS6_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR" & d2$pred_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR")
  FP2 <- sum(d2$PFS6_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR"  & d2$pred_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR")
  TN2 <- sum(d2$PFS6_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR"  & d2$pred_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR")
  c(delta_TPR = ifelse(TP1 + FN1 > 0, TP1 / (TP1 + FN1), NA_real_) - ifelse(TP2 + FN2 > 0, TP2 / (TP2 + FN2), NA_real_), delta_FPR = ifelse(FP1 + TN1 > 0, FP1 / (FP1 + TN1), NA_real_) - ifelse(FP2 + TN2 > 0, FP2 / (FP2 + TN2), NA_real_))
}

stat_delta_older <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- data[indices, ]
  d1 <- d[d$Older == "Elderly", ]
  d2 <- d[d$Older == "Not elderly", ]
  TP1 <- sum(d1$PFS6_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR" & d1$pred_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR")
  FN1 <- sum(d1$PFS6_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR" & d1$pred_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR")
  FP1 <- sum(d1$PFS6_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR"  & d1$pred_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR")
  TN1 <- sum(d1$PFS6_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR"  & d1$pred_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR")
  TP2 <- sum(d2$PFS6_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR" & d2$pred_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR")
  FN2 <- sum(d2$PFS6_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR" & d2$pred_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR")
  FP2 <- sum(d2$PFS6_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR"  & d2$pred_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR")
  TN2 <- sum(d2$PFS6_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR"  & d2$pred_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR")
  c(delta_TPR = ifelse(TP1 + FN1 > 0, TP1 / (TP1 + FN1), NA_real_) - ifelse(TP2 + FN2 > 0, TP2 / (TP2 + FN2), NA_real_), delta_FPR = ifelse(FP1 + TN1 > 0, FP1 / (FP1 + TN1), NA_real_) - ifelse(FP2 + TN2 > 0, FP2 / (FP2 + TN2), NA_real_))
}

stat_delta_frailty <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- data[indices, ]
  d1 <- d[d$Frail == "Frail", ]
  d2 <- d[d$Frail == "Not frail", ]
  TP1 <- sum(d1$PFS6_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR" & d1$pred_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR")
  FN1 <- sum(d1$PFS6_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR" & d1$pred_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR")
  FP1 <- sum(d1$PFS6_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR"  & d1$pred_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR")
  TN1 <- sum(d1$PFS6_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR"  & d1$pred_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR")
  TP2 <- sum(d2$PFS6_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR" & d2$pred_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR")
  FN2 <- sum(d2$PFS6_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR" & d2$pred_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR")
  FP2 <- sum(d2$PFS6_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR"  & d2$pred_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR")
  TN2 <- sum(d2$PFS6_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR"  & d2$pred_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR")
  c(delta_TPR = ifelse(TP1 + FN1 > 0, TP1 / (TP1 + FN1), NA_real_) - ifelse(TP2 + FN2 > 0, TP2 / (TP2 + FN2), NA_real_), delta_FPR = ifelse(FP1 + TN1 > 0, FP1 / (FP1 + TN1), NA_real_) - ifelse(FP2 + TN2 > 0, FP2 / (FP2 + TN2), NA_real_))
}

stat_delta_palbo <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- data[indices, ]
  d1 <- d[d$CDK46i_Drug_Palbo == "Palbociclib", ]
  d2 <- d[d$CDK46i_Drug_Palbo == "Ribociclib or Abemaciclib", ]
  TP1 <- sum(d1$PFS6_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR" & d1$pred_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR")
  FN1 <- sum(d1$PFS6_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR" & d1$pred_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR")
  FP1 <- sum(d1$PFS6_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR"  & d1$pred_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR")
  TN1 <- sum(d1$PFS6_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR"  & d1$pred_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR")
  TP2 <- sum(d2$PFS6_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR" & d2$pred_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR")
  FN2 <- sum(d2$PFS6_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR" & d2$pred_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR")
  FP2 <- sum(d2$PFS6_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR"  & d2$pred_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR")
  TN2 <- sum(d2$PFS6_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR"  & d2$pred_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR")
  c(delta_TPR = ifelse(TP1 + FN1 > 0, TP1 / (TP1 + FN1), NA_real_) - ifelse(TP2 + FN2 > 0, TP2 / (TP2 + FN2), NA_real_), delta_FPR = ifelse(FP1 + TN1 > 0, FP1 / (FP1 + TN1), NA_real_) - ifelse(FP2 + TN2 > 0, FP2 / (FP2 + TN2), NA_real_))
}

PALMARES2_test_RWD_centers$Region <- factor(PALMARES2_test_RWD_centers$Region)
PALMARES2_test_RWD_older$Older <- factor(PALMARES2_test_RWD_older$Older)
PALMARES2_test_RWD_frailty$Frail <- factor(PALMARES2_test_RWD_frailty$Frail)
PALMARES2_test_RWD_palbo$CDK46i_Drug_Palbo <- factor(PALMARES2_test_RWD_palbo$CDK46i_Drug_Palbo)

boot_centers <- boot(data = PALMARES2_test_RWD_centers, statistic = stat_delta_centers, R = R, strata = PALMARES2_test_RWD_centers$Region)
boot_older <- boot(data = PALMARES2_test_RWD_older, statistic = stat_delta_older, R = R, strata = PALMARES2_test_RWD_older$Older)
boot_frailty <- boot(data = PALMARES2_test_RWD_frailty, statistic = stat_delta_frailty, R = R, strata = PALMARES2_test_RWD_frailty$Frail)
boot_palbo <- boot(data = PALMARES2_test_RWD_palbo, statistic = stat_delta_palbo, R = R, strata = PALMARES2_test_RWD_palbo$CDK46i_Drug_Palbo)

#aggregate results
ci_tpr_perc_centers <- boot.ci(boot_centers, type = "perc", index = 1)
ci_fpr_perc_centers <- boot.ci(boot_centers, type = "perc", index = 2)
ci_tpr_perc_older <- boot.ci(boot_older, type = "perc", index = 1)
ci_fpr_perc_older <- boot.ci(boot_older, type = "perc", index = 2)
ci_tpr_perc_frailty <- boot.ci(boot_frailty, type = "perc", index = 1)
ci_fpr_perc_frailty <- boot.ci(boot_frailty, type = "perc", index = 2)
ci_tpr_perc_palbo <- boot.ci(boot_palbo, type = "perc", index = 1)
ci_fpr_perc_palbo <- boot.ci(boot_palbo, type = "perc", index = 2)

TPR_centers_tot <- sprintf("%.3f (%.3f – %.3f)", boot_centers$t0[1], ci_tpr_perc_centers$percent[4], ci_tpr_perc_centers$percent[5])
FPR_centers_tot <- sprintf("%.3f (%.3f – %.3f)", boot_centers$t0[2], ci_fpr_perc_centers$percent[4], ci_fpr_perc_centers$percent[5])
TPR_older_tot <- sprintf("%.3f (%.3f – %.3f)", boot_older$t0[1], ci_tpr_perc_older$percent[4], ci_tpr_perc_older$percent[5])
FPR_older_tot <- sprintf("%.3f (%.3f – %.3f)", boot_older$t0[2], ci_fpr_perc_older$percent[4], ci_fpr_perc_older$percent[5])
TPR_frail_tot <- sprintf("%.3f (%.3f – %.3f)", boot_frailty$t0[1], ci_tpr_perc_frailty$percent[4], ci_tpr_perc_frailty$percent[5])
FPR_frail_tot <- sprintf("%.3f (%.3f – %.3f)", boot_frailty$t0[2], ci_fpr_perc_frailty$percent[4], ci_fpr_perc_frailty$percent[5])
TPR_palbo_tot <- sprintf("%.3f (%.3f – %.3f)", boot_palbo$t0[1], ci_tpr_perc_palbo$percent[4], ci_tpr_perc_palbo$percent[5])
FPR_palbo_tot <- sprintf("%.3f (%.3f – %.3f)", boot_palbo$t0[2], ci_fpr_perc_palbo$percent[4], ci_fpr_perc_palbo$percent[5])

table_equalized_odds <- data.frame(Category = c("Patients enrolled in South Italy hospitals", "Older patients", "Frail patients", "Patients treated with palbociclib"), TPR_difference_protected_vs_not_protected_groups = c(TPR_centers_tot, TPR_older_tot, TPR_frail_tot, TPR_palbo_tot), FPR_difference_protected_vs_not_protected_groups = c(FPR_centers_tot, FPR_older_tot, FPR_frail_tot, FPR_palbo_tot))

#permutation test
set.seed(51)
B <- 10000
p_values_equalized_odds_perm <- data.frame()

comparisons <- list(
  list(data = PALMARES2_test_RWD_centers, group_var = "Region", protected_group = "South Italy", reference_group = "North or Center Italy", comparison_name = "Patients enrolled in South Italy hospitals"),
  list(data = PALMARES2_test_RWD_older, group_var = "Older", protected_group = "Elderly", reference_group = "Not elderly", comparison_name = "Older patients"),
  list(data = PALMARES2_test_RWD_frailty, group_var = "Frail", protected_group = "Frail", reference_group = "Not frail", comparison_name = "Frail patients"),
  list(data = PALMARES2_test_RWD_palbo, group_var = "CDK46i_Drug_Palbo", protected_group = "Palbociclib", reference_group = "Ribociclib or Abemaciclib", comparison_name = "Patients treated with palbociclib")
)

for (comp in comparisons) {
  d <- comp$data
  d_protected <- d %>% filter(.data[[comp$group_var]] == comp$protected_group)
  d_reference <- d %>% filter(.data[[comp$group_var]] == comp$reference_group)
  TP1 <- sum(d_protected$PFS6_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR" & d_protected$pred_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR", na.rm = TRUE)
  FN1 <- sum(d_protected$PFS6_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR" & d_protected$pred_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR", na.rm = TRUE)
  FP1 <- sum(d_protected$PFS6_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR" & d_protected$pred_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR", na.rm = TRUE)
  TN1 <- sum(d_protected$PFS6_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR" & d_protected$pred_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR", na.rm = TRUE)
  TP2 <- sum(d_reference$PFS6_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR" & d_reference$pred_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR", na.rm = TRUE)
  FN2 <- sum(d_reference$PFS6_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR" & d_reference$pred_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR", na.rm = TRUE)
  FP2 <- sum(d_reference$PFS6_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR" & d_reference$pred_chr == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR", na.rm = TRUE)
  TN2 <- sum(d_reference$PFS6_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR" & d_reference$pred_chr == "LATE_PROGRESSOR", na.rm = TRUE)
  TPR_1 <- ifelse(TP1 + FN1 > 0, TP1 / (TP1 + FN1), NA_real_)
  TPR_2 <- ifelse(TP2 + FN2 > 0, TP2 / (TP2 + FN2), NA_real_)
  FPR_1 <- ifelse(FP1 + TN1 > 0, FP1 / (FP1 + TN1), NA_real_)
  FPR_2 <- ifelse(FP2 + TN2 > 0, FP2 / (FP2 + TN2), NA_real_)
  obs_delta_TPR <- TPR_1 - TPR_2
  obs_delta_FPR <- FPR_1 - FPR_2
  pred_TPR <- c(rep(1, TP1), rep(0, FN1), rep(1, TP2), rep(0, FN2))
  group_TPR <- c(rep("Protected", TP1 + FN1), rep("Reference", TP2 + FN2))
  perm_delta_TPR <- replicate(B, {
    g <- sample(group_TPR)
    mean(pred_TPR[g == "Protected"]) - mean(pred_TPR[g == "Reference"])
  })
  p_TPR_perm <- (sum(abs(perm_delta_TPR) >= abs(obs_delta_TPR), na.rm = TRUE) + 1) / (B + 1)
  pred_FPR <- c(rep(1, FP1), rep(0, TN1), rep(1, FP2), rep(0, TN2))
  group_FPR <- c(rep("Protected", FP1 + TN1), rep("Reference", FP2 + TN2))
  perm_delta_FPR <- replicate(B, {
    g <- sample(group_FPR)
    mean(pred_FPR[g == "Protected"]) - mean(pred_FPR[g == "Reference"])
  })
  p_FPR_perm <- (sum(abs(perm_delta_FPR) >= abs(obs_delta_FPR), na.rm = TRUE) + 1) / (B + 1)
  temp_results <- data.frame(
    Comparison = c(comp$comparison_name, comp$comparison_name),
    Metric = c("TPR", "FPR"),
    Protected_group = c(comp$protected_group, comp$protected_group),
    Reference_group = c(comp$reference_group, comp$reference_group),
    Protected_group_rate = c(TPR_1, FPR_1),
    Reference_group_rate = c(TPR_2, FPR_2),
    Difference_protected_minus_reference = c(obs_delta_TPR, obs_delta_FPR),
    p_value_permutation = c(p_TPR_perm, p_FPR_perm)
  )
  p_values_equalized_odds_perm <- bind_rows(p_values_equalized_odds_perm, temp_results)
}

p_values_equalized_odds_perm[, c("Protected_group_rate", "Reference_group_rate", "Difference_protected_minus_reference", "p_value_permutation")] <- round(p_values_equalized_odds_perm[, c("Protected_group_rate", "Reference_group_rate", "Difference_protected_minus_reference", "p_value_permutation")], 3)


#equalized odds table
p_perm_wide <- p_values_equalized_odds_perm %>%
  select(Comparison, Metric, p_value_permutation) %>%
  mutate(p_value_permutation = ifelse(p_value_permutation < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p_value_permutation))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Metric, values_from = p_value_permutation) %>%
  rename(Category = Comparison, `P for ΔTPR (permutation test)` = TPR, `P for ΔFPR (permutation test)` = FPR)

table_equalized_odds_with_p <- table_equalized_odds %>%
  left_join(p_perm_wide, by = "Category") %>%
  select(Category, `ΔTPR (protected vs. not protected group)` = TPR_difference_protected_vs_not_protected_groups, `P for ΔTPR (permutation test)`, `ΔFPR (protected vs. not protected group)` = FPR_difference_protected_vs_not_protected_groups,`P for ΔFPR (permutation test)`)

write.xlsx(table_equalized_odds_with_p, file = "C:/Users/leona/Desktop/PALMARES-2/PALMARES2_ML/Paper_Figures/table_equalized_odds_with_p.xlsx")
```

```{r}
###GLOBAL EXPLAINABILITY
# explainability on test set
target <- as.numeric(ifelse(PALMARES2_test_RWD$PFS6 == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR",1,0))
PALMARES2_test_RWD_filtered <- PALMARES2_test_RWD %>% dplyr::select(-PFS6)

target_train <- as.numeric(ifelse(PALMARES2_train_RWD$PFS6 == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR",1,0))
PALMARES2_train_RWD_filtered <- PALMARES2_train_RWD %>% dplyr::select(-PFS6)

predictor <- Predictor$new(model_glmnet_rwd, data = PALMARES2_train_RWD_filtered, y = target_train)

shap_results <- lapply(1:nrow(PALMARES2_test_RWD), function(i) {
  shapley <- Shapley$new(predictor, x.interest = PALMARES2_test_RWD_filtered[i, ])
  shap_df <- shapley$results
  shap_df$patient_id <- i  
  return(shap_df)
})

shap_df_all <- do.call(rbind, shap_results)

# filter only positive class and exclude features with phi = 0
shap_df_all <- shap_df_all[shap_df_all$class == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR", ]
shap_df_all <- shap_df_all[shap_df_all$phi != 0, ]

# extract and convert features as numeric
shap_df_all$feature.value.numeric <- as.numeric(sub(".*=", "", shap_df_all$feature.value))

# calculate mean for each feature
feature_counts <- shap_df_all %>% count(feature, name = "freq")

shap_feature_stats <- shap_df_all %>%
  group_by(feature) %>%
  summarise(mean_abs_phi = mean(abs(phi), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  inner_join(feature_counts, by = "feature") %>%
  filter(freq >= 10)
shap_df_filtered <- shap_df_all %>%
  inner_join(shap_feature_stats, by = "feature")

top_features <- shap_feature_stats %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_abs_phi)) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1:15) %>%
  pull(feature)

shap_df_top15 <- shap_df_filtered %>%
  filter(feature %in% top_features)

SHAP_global_test <- ggplot(shap_df_top15, aes(x = reorder(feature, mean_abs_phi), y = phi, color = feature.value.numeric)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(group = patient_id), alpha = 0.7, width = 0.1, height = 0) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Global SHAP on test set", x = "Feature", y = "SHAP value", color = "Feature Value") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8), plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0.5))

#explainability on independent validation set
target_extval <- as.numeric(ifelse(PALMARES2_extval_RWD$PFS6 == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR",1,0))
PALMARES2_extval_RWD_filtered <- PALMARES2_extval_RWD %>% dplyr::select(-PFS6)

shap_results_extval <- lapply(1:nrow(PALMARES2_extval_RWD), function(i) {
  shapley <- Shapley$new(predictor, x.interest = PALMARES2_extval_RWD_filtered[i, ])
  shap_df <- shapley$results
  shap_df$patient_id <- i  
  return(shap_df)
})
shap_df_all_extval <- do.call(rbind, shap_results_extval) 

shap_df_all_extval <- shap_df_all_extval[shap_df_all_extval$class == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR", ]
shap_df_all_extval <- shap_df_all_extval[shap_df_all_extval$phi != 0, ]

shap_df_all_extval$feature.value.numeric <- as.numeric(sub(".*=", "", shap_df_all_extval$feature.value))

feature_counts_extval <- shap_df_all_extval %>% count(feature, name = "freq")

shap_feature_stats_extval <- shap_df_all_extval %>%
  group_by(feature) %>%
  summarise(mean_abs_phi = mean(abs(phi), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  inner_join(feature_counts_extval, by = "feature") %>%

shap_df_filtered_extval <- shap_df_all_extval %>%

top_features_extval <- shap_feature_stats_extval %>%

shap_df_top15_extval <- shap_df_filtered_extval %>%

SHAP_global_extval <- ggplot(shap_df_top15_extval, aes(x = reorder(feature, mean_abs_phi), y = phi, color = feature.value.numeric)) +

explainability_global <- plot_grid(NULL, SHAP_global_test, NULL, SHAP_global_extval, NULL, ncol = 5, align = "hv", axis = "tb", rel_widths = c(0.2, 1, 0.2, 1, 0.2), labels = c("", "a", "", "b", ""), label_size = 14, label_fontface = "bold", label_x = 0.02, label_y = 0.98)


###local explainability
#recalibrate predictions on unbalanced train distribution before explaining
logit_safe <- function(p, eps = 1e-6) {
  p <- pmin(pmax(p, eps), 1 - eps)
  log(p / (1 - p))
}

p_raw <- predict(model_glmnet_rwd, newdata = PALMARES2_train_RWD_unbalanced_normalized, type = "prob")[, "EARLY_PROGRESSOR"]
fit_cal_glm <- glm(as.numeric(PALMARES2_train_RWD_unbalanced_normalized$PFS6 == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR") ~ logit_safe(p_raw), family = binomial())

pred_fun <- local({
  fit_cal_glm <- fit_cal_glm
  function(m, newdata) {
    p <- predict(m, newdata = newdata, type = "prob")[, "EARLY_PROGRESSOR"]
    plogis(coef(fit_cal_glm)[1] + coef(fit_cal_glm)[2] * logit_safe(p))
  }
})

X_train <- PALMARES2_train_RWD_unbalanced_normalized[, c(sel_features_RWD)]
y_train <- as.numeric(PALMARES2_train_RWD_unbalanced_normalized$PFS6 == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR")

exp_glmnet <- DALEX::explain(
  model = model_glmnet_rwd,
  data = X_train,
  y = y_train,
  predict_function = pred_fun,
  label = " "
)

#TP
TPs <- PALMARES2_test_RWD$index[PALMARES2_test_RWD$PFS6 == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR" & predict(model_glmnet_rwd, newdata = PALMARES2_test_RWD, type = "prob")[,"EARLY_PROGRESSOR"] > 0.5]
#TN
TNs <- PALMARES2_test_RWD$index[PALMARES2_test_RWD$PFS6 == "LATE_PROGRESSOR" & predict(model_glmnet_rwd, newdata = PALMARES2_test_RWD, type = "prob")[,"EARLY_PROGRESSOR"] < 0.5]
#FP
FPs <- PALMARES2_test_RWD$index[PALMARES2_test_RWD$PFS6 == "LATE_PROGRESSOR" & predict(model_glmnet_rwd, newdata = PALMARES2_test_RWD, type = "prob")[,"EARLY_PROGRESSOR"] > 0.5]
#FN
FNs <- PALMARES2_test_RWD$index[PALMARES2_test_RWD$PFS6 == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR" & predict(model_glmnet_rwd, newdata = PALMARES2_test_RWD, type = "prob")[,"EARLY_PROGRESSOR"] < 0.5]


x_explain_TP <- PALMARES2_test_RWD[TPs[1], colnames(X_train), drop = FALSE]
x_raw_TP <- PALMARES2_test_RWD_balanced[TPs[1], colnames(X_train), drop = FALSE]

shap_local_TP <- predict_parts(explainer = exp_glmnet, new_observation = x_explain_TP, type = "break_down", B = 200)
shap_local_TP$variable <- sapply(shap_local_TP$variable, function(v) {
  v <- as.character(v)
  if (grepl("=", v)) {
    var_name <- trimws(sub("\\s*=.*", "", v))
    if (var_name %in% colnames(x_raw_TP)) {
      raw_value <- x_raw_TP[[var_name]][1]
      if (!is.na(raw_value)) {
        v <- sub("=\\s*.*", paste0("= ", sprintf("%.2f", as.numeric(raw_value))), v)
      }
    }
  }
  v
})
```

```{r}
PALMARES2_calibration_curves_train_glmnet_rwd_plot <- plot_grid(PALMARES2_calibration_curves_train_glmnet_rwd_plot$plot, PALMARES2_calibration_curves_train_glmnet_rwd_plot$table, ncol = 1, align = "v", rel_heights = c(5, 1))

annals_palette <- c("#00305d", "#81144e", "#79831e", "#1c4f27")

logit_safe <- function(x, eps = 1e-6) qlogis(pmin(pmax(as.numeric(x), eps), 1 - eps))
fit_cal_glm_norm <- glm(as.numeric(PALMARES2_train_RWD_unbalanced_normalized$PFS6 == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR") ~ logit_safe(predict(model_glmnet_rwd, newdata = PALMARES2_train_RWD_unbalanced_normalized, type = "prob")[, "EARLY_PROGRESSOR"]), family = binomial())

### Recalibrated OOF probabilities
prob_oof_raw <- PALMARES2_train_glmnet_rwd_KM$EARLY_PROGRESSOR
obs_oof <- PALMARES2_train_glmnet_rwd_KM$PFS6
valid_rows <- complete.cases(prob_oof_raw, obs_oof)
prob_oof_raw <- as.numeric(prob_oof_raw[valid_rows])
obs_oof <- obs_oof[valid_rows]
obs_oof <- ifelse(obs_oof %in% c(1, "1", "EARLY_PROGRESSOR"), 1, 0)
prob_oof <- plogis(coef(fit_cal_glm_norm)[1] + coef(fit_cal_glm_norm)[2] * logit_safe(prob_oof_raw))
obs_early <- obs_oof == 1

### Cut-off optimization on recalibrated OOF predictions
candidate_cutoffs <- sort(unique(c(0, prob_oof, 1)))
cutoff_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(candidate_cutoffs, function(cutoff) {
  pred_early <- prob_oof >= cutoff
  TP <- sum(pred_early & obs_early)
  FN <- sum(!pred_early & obs_early)
  TN <- sum(!pred_early & !obs_early)
  FP <- sum(pred_early & !obs_early)
  sensitivity <- ifelse(TP + FN > 0, TP / (TP + FN), NA_real_)
  specificity <- ifelse(TN + FP > 0, TN / (TN + FP), NA_real_)
  precision <- ifelse(TP + FP > 0, TP / (TP + FP), NA_real_)
  NPV <- ifelse(TN + FN > 0, TN / (TN + FN), NA_real_)
  accuracy <- (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN)
  balanced_accuracy <- (sensitivity + specificity) / 2
  youden_index <- sensitivity + specificity - 1
  data.frame(cutoff = cutoff, sensitivity = sensitivity, specificity = specificity, precision = precision, NPV = NPV, accuracy = accuracy, balanced_accuracy = balanced_accuracy, youden_index = youden_index, TP = TP, FN = FN, TN = TN, FP = FP)
}))
cutoff_table <- cutoff_table[complete.cases(cutoff_table[, c("sensitivity", "specificity", "youden_index")]),]

### Highest sensitivity among cutoffs with specificity >=50%
eligible_specificity <- cutoff_table[cutoff_table$specificity >= 0.50,]
if (nrow(eligible_specificity) == 0) stop("Nessun cutoff raggiunge una specificità >=50%.")
eligible_specificity <- eligible_specificity[order(-eligible_specificity$sensitivity, -eligible_specificity$specificity, -eligible_specificity$youden_index, eligible_specificity$cutoff),]
best_high_sensitivity <- eligible_specificity[1,]

### Highest specificity among cutoffs with sensitivity >=50%
eligible_sensitivity <- cutoff_table[cutoff_table$sensitivity >= 0.50,]
if (nrow(eligible_sensitivity) == 0) stop("Nessun cutoff raggiunge una sensibilità >=50%.")
eligible_sensitivity <- eligible_sensitivity[order(-eligible_sensitivity$specificity, -eligible_sensitivity$sensitivity, -eligible_sensitivity$youden_index, eligible_sensitivity$cutoff),]
best_high_specificity <- eligible_sensitivity[1,]
selected_cutoffs <- rbind(cbind(criterion = "Highest sensitivity with specificity >=50%", best_high_sensitivity), cbind(criterion = "Highest specificity with sensitivity >=50%", best_high_specificity))
rownames(selected_cutoffs) <- NULL
cutoff_high_sens <- as.numeric(best_high_sensitivity$cutoff)
cutoff_high_spec <- as.numeric(best_high_specificity$cutoff)

### Recalibrated probabilities in test set
prob_glmnet_test_rwd_raw <- predict(model_glmnet_rwd, newdata = PALMARES2_test_RWD, type = "prob")[, "EARLY_PROGRESSOR"]
prob_glmnet_test_rwd <- plogis(coef(fit_cal_glm_norm)[1] + coef(fit_cal_glm_norm)[2] * logit_safe(prob_glmnet_test_rwd_raw))
PALMARES2_test_glmnet_rwd_KM <- PALMARES2_test_KM %>% mutate(prob_early_calibrated = as.numeric(prob_glmnet_test_rwd), cutoff_HighSens = ifelse(prob_early_calibrated >= cutoff_high_sens, "EARLY_PROGRESSOR", "LATE_PROGRESSOR"), cutoff_HighSpec = ifelse(prob_early_calibrated >= cutoff_high_spec, "EARLY_PROGRESSOR", "LATE_PROGRESSOR"))
PALMARES2_test_glmnet_rwd_KM$cutoff_HighSens <- relevel(factor(PALMARES2_test_glmnet_rwd_KM$cutoff_HighSens), ref = "LATE_PROGRESSOR")
PALMARES2_test_glmnet_rwd_KM$cutoff_HighSpec <- relevel(factor(PALMARES2_test_glmnet_rwd_KM$cutoff_HighSpec), ref = "LATE_PROGRESSOR")

### Recalibrated probabilities in independent validation set

prob_glmnet_extval_rwd <- plogis(coef(fit_cal_glm_norm)[1] + coef(fit_cal_glm_norm)[2] * logit_safe(prob_glmnet_extval_rwd_raw))
PALMARES2_extval_glmnet_rwd_KM <- PALMARES2_extval_KM %>% mutate(prob_early_calibrated = as.numeric(prob_glmnet_extval_rwd), cutoff_HighSens = ifelse(prob_early_calibrated >= cutoff_high_sens, "EARLY_PROGRESSOR", "LATE_PROGRESSOR"), cutoff_HighSpec = ifelse(prob_early_calibrated >= cutoff_high_spec, "EARLY_PROGRESSOR", "LATE_PROGRESSOR"))
PALMARES2_extval_glmnet_rwd_KM$cutoff_HighSens <- relevel(factor(PALMARES2_extval_glmnet_rwd_KM$cutoff_HighSens), ref = "LATE_PROGRESSOR")
PALMARES2_extval_glmnet_rwd_KM$cutoff_HighSpec <- relevel(factor(PALMARES2_extval_glmnet_rwd_KM$cutoff_HighSpec), ref = "LATE_PROGRESSOR")

### Sensitivity, specificity and other metrics in test and independent validation sets
get_cutoff_metrics <- function(data, observed, predicted, dataset, cutoff_type) {
  obs <- data[[observed]]
  pred <- data[[predicted]]
  valid_rows <- complete.cases(obs, pred)
  obs <- obs[valid_rows]
  pred <- pred[valid_rows]
  obs_early <- obs %in% c(1, "1", "EARLY_PROGRESSOR")
  pred_early <- pred == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR"
  TP <- sum(pred_early & obs_early)
  FN <- sum(!pred_early & obs_early)
  TN <- sum(!pred_early & !obs_early)
  FP <- sum(pred_early & !obs_early)
  sensitivity <- ifelse(TP + FN > 0, TP / (TP + FN), NA_real_)
  specificity <- ifelse(TN + FP > 0, TN / (TN + FP), NA_real_)
  precision <- ifelse(TP + FP > 0, TP / (TP + FP), NA_real_)
  NPV <- ifelse(TN + FN > 0, TN / (TN + FN), NA_real_)
  accuracy <- (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN)
  balanced_accuracy <- (sensitivity + specificity) / 2
  data.frame(dataset = dataset, cutoff_type = cutoff_type, sensitivity = sensitivity, specificity = specificity, precision = precision, NPV = NPV, accuracy = accuracy, balanced_accuracy = balanced_accuracy, TP = TP, FN = FN, TN = TN, FP = FP)
}

metrics_test_highsens <- get_cutoff_metrics(PALMARES2_test_glmnet_rwd_KM, "PFS6", "cutoff_HighSens", "Test set", "High-sensitivity cutoff")
metrics_test_highspec <- get_cutoff_metrics(PALMARES2_test_glmnet_rwd_KM, "PFS6", "cutoff_HighSpec", "Test set", "High-specificity cutoff")
metrics_extval_highsens <- get_cutoff_metrics(PALMARES2_extval_glmnet_rwd_KM, "PFS6", "cutoff_HighSens", "Independent validation set", "High-sensitivity cutoff")
metrics_extval_highspec <- get_cutoff_metrics(PALMARES2_extval_glmnet_rwd_KM, "PFS6", "cutoff_HighSpec", "Independent validation set", "High-specificity cutoff")
cutoff_metrics <- rbind(metrics_test_highsens, metrics_test_highspec, metrics_extval_highsens, metrics_extval_highspec)
cutoff_metrics[, c("sensitivity", "specificity", "precision", "NPV", "accuracy", "balanced_accuracy")] <- round(cutoff_metrics[, c("sensitivity", "specificity", "precision", "NPV", "accuracy", "balanced_accuracy")] * 100, 1)
print(cutoff_metrics)

### Quartile cutpoints derived exclusively from recalibrated OOF training predictions
quartile_cutpoints <- quantile(prob_oof, probs = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)
if (length(unique(quartile_cutpoints)) < 3) stop("I cutpoint dei quartili non sono tutti distinti. Controllare la distribuzione delle probabilità.")
q25 <- quartile_cutpoints[1]
q50 <- quartile_cutpoints[2]
q75 <- quartile_cutpoints[3]
quartile_breaks <- c(-Inf, q25, q50, q75, Inf)
print(c(Q1_Q2 = q25, Q2_Q3 = q50, Q3_Q4 = q75))

to01 <- function(x, luminal = FALSE) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  if (luminal) {
    ifelse(x %in% c("LUMINAL B", "LUMINAL_B", "B", "1"), 1, ifelse(x %in% c("LUMINAL A", "LUMINAL_A", "A", "0"), 0, NA))
  } else {
    ifelse(x %in% c("1", "EARLY_PROGRESSOR", "EARLY"), 1, ifelse(x %in% c("0", "LATE_PROGRESSOR", "LATE"), 0, NA))
  }
}

get_metrics <- function(actual, predicted, luminal = FALSE) {
  d <- na.omit(data.frame(actual = to01(actual), predicted = to01(predicted, luminal)))
  cm <- table(factor(d$actual, levels = 0:1), factor(d$predicted, levels = 0:1))
  TN <- cm["0", "0"]; FP <- cm["0", "1"]
  FN <- cm["1", "0"]; TP <- cm["1", "1"]
  sens <- TP / (TP + FN)
  spec <- TN / (TN + FP)
  tibble(N = sum(cm), Balanced_accuracy = mean(c(sens, spec)), Sensitivity = sens, Specificity = spec)
}

results_benchmarking <- bind_rows(get_metrics(PALMARES2_test_glmnet_rwd_benchmark$PFS6, PALMARES2_test_glmnet_rwd_benchmark$Endocrine_Resistance) %>% mutate(Dataset = "Test set", Predictor = "Endocrine resistance"),
  get_metrics(PALMARES2_test_glmnet_rwd_benchmark$PFS6, PALMARES2_test_glmnet_rwd_benchmark$Luminal, luminal = TRUE) %>% mutate(Dataset = "Test set", Predictor = "Luminal subtype"),
  get_metrics(PALMARES2_test_glmnet_rwd_benchmark$PFS6, PALMARES2_test_glmnet_rwd_benchmark$pred) %>% mutate(Dataset = "Test set", Predictor = "GLMNET model"),
  get_metrics(PALMARES2_extval_glmnet_rwd_benchmark$PFS6, PALMARES2_extval_glmnet_rwd_benchmark$Endocrine_Resistance) %>% mutate(Dataset = "External validation", Predictor = "Endocrine resistance"),
  get_metrics(PALMARES2_extval_glmnet_rwd_benchmark$PFS6, PALMARES2_extval_glmnet_rwd_benchmark$Luminal, luminal = TRUE) %>% mutate(Dataset = "External validation", Predictor = "Luminal subtype"),
  get_metrics(PALMARES2_extval_glmnet_rwd_benchmark$PFS6, PALMARES2_extval_glmnet_rwd_benchmark$pred) %>% mutate(Dataset = "External validation", Predictor = "GLMNET model")) %>%
  select(Dataset, Predictor, N, Balanced_accuracy, Sensitivity, Specificity) %>% mutate(across(c(Balanced_accuracy, Sensitivity, Specificity), ~ round(.x, 3)))

write.xlsx(results_benchmarking, file = "C:/Users/leona/Desktop/PALMARES-2/PALMARES2_ML/Paper_Figures/results_benchmarking.xlsx")
```

```{r}
###Forest plot showing the impact of early progression in multivariate Cox regression model on rwTTC and rwOS
PALMARES2_2025_cox <- PALMARES2_2025 %>% select(PFS6, Age , PS_ECOG , Menopausal_status , Histology , Endocrine_Resistance , ER_combined , PgR_combined , Ki67_combined , Liver_Met , Lung_Met , Bone_Met, TTC_time, TTC_event, OS_time, OS_event)
PALMARES2_2025_cox$Histology <- ifelse(PALMARES2_2025_cox$Histology == "CLI", "ILC", PALMARES2_2025_cox$Histology)

recipe_cox <- recipe(PFS6 ~ ., data = PALMARES2_2025_cox) %>% update_role(PFS6, new_role = "outcome") %>% step_impute_bag(all_predictors())
recipe_cox_trained <- prep(recipe_cox, training = PALMARES2_2025_cox)
PALMARES2_2025_cox <- bake(recipe_cox_trained, new_data = NULL)

PALMARES2_2025_cox <- PALMARES2_2025_cox %>% mutate(PS_ECOG = case_when(PS_ECOG %in% c(2, 3, 4) ~ ">=2", TRUE ~ PS_ECOG))
PALMARES2_2025_cox$PS_ECOG <- factor(PALMARES2_2025_cox$PS_ECOG, levels = c("0", "1", ">=2")) 
PALMARES2_2025_cox$Histology <- relevel(as.factor(PALMARES2_2025_cox$Histology), ref = "NST")
PALMARES2_2025_cox$Endocrine_Resistance <- as.numeric(PALMARES2_2025_cox$Endocrine_Resistance)

PALMARES2_2025_cox <- PALMARES2_2025_cox %>% 
  mutate(ER10 = ER_combined/10, PgR10 = PgR_combined/10, Ki6710 = Ki67_combined/10) %>% 
  rename(`6-months rwPFS status` = PFS6, `Menopausal status` = Menopausal_status, `Endocrine resistance` = Endocrine_Resistance, `Age (years)` = Age, `ECOG PS` = PS_ECOG, `Liver metastasis` = Liver_Met, `Lung metastasis` = Lung_Met, `Bone metastasis` = Bone_Met, `ER expression (per 10% increase)` = ER10, `PgR expression (per 10% increase)` = PgR10, `Ki67 expression (per 10% increase)` = Ki6710)

EarlyPD_Cox_multivariate_TTC <- coxph(Surv(TTC_time, TTC_event) ~ `6-months rwPFS status` + `Age (years)` + `ECOG PS` + `Menopausal status` + Histology + `Endocrine resistance` + `ER expression (per 10% increase)` + `PgR expression (per 10% increase)` + `Ki67 expression (per 10% increase)` + `Liver metastasis` + `Lung metastasis` + `Bone metastasis`, data = PALMARES2_2025_cox, x = TRUE)
EarlyPD_Cox_multivariate_TTC_plot <- forest_model(EarlyPD_Cox_multivariate_TTC)

EarlyPD_Cox_multivariate_OS <- coxph(Surv(OS_time, OS_event) ~ `6-months rwPFS status` + `Age (years)` + `ECOG PS` + `Menopausal status` + Histology + `Endocrine resistance` + `ER expression (per 10% increase)` + `PgR expression (per 10% increase)` + `Ki67 expression (per 10% increase)` + `Liver metastasis` + `Lung metastasis` + `Bone metastasis`, data = PALMARES2_2025_cox, x=TRUE)
EarlyPD_Cox_multivariate_OS_plot <- forest_model(EarlyPD_Cox_multivariate_OS)

Figure_EarlyPD_Cox_multivariate <- plot_grid(EarlyPD_Cox_multivariate_TTC_plot, EarlyPD_Cox_multivariate_OS_plot, ncol = 2, align = "hv", axis = "tb")
Figure_EarlyPD_Cox_multivariate <- ggdraw() + draw_plot(Figure_EarlyPD_Cox_multivariate, x = 0, y = 0, width = 1, height = 0.95) + draw_plot_label(label = c("a", "b"), x = c(0.01, 0.51), y = 0.975, size = 16, fontface = "bold")

ggsave(filename = "C:/Users/leona/Desktop/PALMARES-2/PALMARES2_ML/Paper_Figures/Figure_S2_EarlyPD_Cox_multivariate.svg",  Figure_EarlyPD_Cox_multivariate,  width = 20, height = 12, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
###statistical tests to test difference between main model and the semplified version used in the online calculator
#DeLong test
y_test <- as.numeric(PALMARES2_test_RWD$PFS6 == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR")  # 1=event

p1 <- predict(model_glmnet_rwd, newdata = PALMARES2_test_RWD, type = "prob")[, "EARLY_PROGRESSOR"]
p2 <- predict(model_glmnet_rwd_calculator, newdata = PALMARES2_test_RWD_calculator, type = "prob")[, "EARLY_PROGRESSOR"]

roc1 <- pROC::roc(response = y_test, predictor = p1, levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<", quiet = TRUE)
roc2 <- pROC::roc(response = y_test, predictor = p2, levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<", quiet = TRUE)

delong <- roc.test(roc1, roc2, method = "delong", paired = TRUE)
delong

#McNemar test
y <- as.numeric(PALMARES2_test_RWD$PFS6 == "EARLY_PROGRESSOR")

p1 <- predict(model_glmnet_rwd, PALMARES2_test_RWD, type="prob")[,"EARLY_PROGRESSOR"]
p2 <- predict(model_glmnet_rwd_calculator, PALMARES2_test_RWD_calculator, type="prob")[,"EARLY_PROGRESSOR"]

cutoff <- 0.5
c1 <- ifelse(p1 >= cutoff, 1, 0)
c2 <- ifelse(p2 >= cutoff, 1, 0)

tab <- table(c1, c2)
mcnemar.test(tab)
```
